meta_description:
948 likes, 21 comments - the_unconventional_ca on September 27, 2026: "₹80 lakh ki luxury car… effectively ₹27 lakh ki? 👀

Sounds ridiculous, until you understand how business owners look at expensive purchases.

Depreciation benefits.
Lower EV running costs.
Resale value.
Loan interest deductions.
And the part most people completely ignore — how the right asset can actually help you make more money.

An ₹80 lakh car is still an ₹80 lakh car. But what it ultimately costs you can be a very different number.

Watch till the end — because the most unconventional benefit has nothing to do with tax. 👀

Calculations are illustrative and depend on business use, tax structure, eligibility, financing, actual running costs and resale value. Consult a tax professional before making a purchase decision.

#Entrepreneurship #LuxuryCars #personalfinanceindia BusinessFinance MGIndia #MGM9 #MGCyberster PersonalFinance".
